title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Issue of Which Type of Legal Document Shall Be Applied for Confirming and Handling Invalid Economic Contracts

articles.content_en:
4. The opinion of our court dated September 17, 1984, "Opinions on the Confirmation and Handling Methods of Invalid Contracts" in the "Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Implementation of the Economic Contract Law", shall be abolished as of the date of issuance of this Reply.
January 20, 1990
